title: wolfssl_rsa_verify: memcmp is not constant-time (timing side-channel)
description: wolfssl_rsa_verify calls memcmp(out, expected, expected_len) to compare the RSA-recovered DigestInfo against the expected DigestInfo. memcmp is not constant-time: it returns as soon as bytes diverge. This is a timing side-channel: an adversary who can submit many signatures and measure verification latency can distinguish which bytes of the DigestInfo mismatch (prefix vs digest). For PKCS#1 v1.5 this leaks information about the recovered plaintext. Fix: use crypto_memneq() (kernel's constant-time compare) or memcmp_time_const from the wolfCrypt API.
